_comment: NEGATIVE FIXTURE N07 — dead transition. A minimal WF-net src -> t_a -> p_mid -> t_b -> sink, plus a transition t_dead whose ONLY input place p_orphan is never produced by any transition (no arc ends at p_orphan). t_dead can never be enabled at any reachable marking, so soundness condition 1 (no dead transitions) fails: analyze_petri_net reports is_sound=false and dead_transitions=["t_dead" label]. Minimal counterexample: delete t_dead and p_orphan and the net is sound.
